notes.title: No Time to Loot 2025 - Demo Updates!
notes.content: [p][i]Hyper Sentinel Fusion[/i] has been selected for [b]No Time to Loot 2025[/b] - LIVE NOW![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554507/219d5b12ecd6a9b6a29496af8ad6fe8efa90433c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Demo Updated[/b][/p][p]To celebrate, we have updated the demo with some bells & whistles, touches here and there, and quality of life improvements. Give it a whirl![/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Sept 2025 - Geon Playtest Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p]Section 1 of the second level - Geon - is just about ready to playtest. Check out the video below, and join our [url="https://discord.gg/kDFyDVwpBr"]Discord[/url] if you want to help with the playtesting & feedback process![/p][p][/p][p]Geon - Section 1:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mZCVCbCL7I8"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Our animator has also been working on prop animations for the Geon droid sections:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8XIRzMpVPoU"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Meanwhile, some early work has begun on level 3 - Brannon. Below you can see a sneak speak of the Turbo Turret being tested for this level:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BKmsehsxTV8"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]And here is a new "spinner" enemy being tested too:
[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/-2R2GxrchOw?si=ZHJO7PIv5UneBTR0"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Finally, here's a super-early test of the second section for Geon, which will be water based. Nothing much to see yet, but you can begin to get a feel for how a water level might look as a very basic test:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OoQqYML6tkU"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Dev Log - Summer 25
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554507/cb7ff59cfed14e210864687bffd41b6b36ecc591.png"][/img][/p][p]As we prepare for the new upcoming [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/robhwson/hyper-sentinel-fusion-2"]Kickstarter campaign[/url], we're going to drop regular updates on development![/p][p]As you can see we have refreshed the games logo, making the "wings" more stream-lined (with a nod to Gradius) and adding an icon to the "O" in "Fusion" to help players instantly understand the kind of game it is. We've also made the capsule simpler and cleaner, to as it is often displayed in different parts of the store quite small. Here's a video devlog of what we've been up to:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Il-2E8ULRpY;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We have been busy here working on the tilesets for Geon, the second level, which we need lots of to seed the procedural generation. Here is an example of one which has been stitched together:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554507/be3e58222b5320ba913f869b7f1102fa8a01f897.png"][/img][/p][p]Here is a work-in-progress test video of the level to give us an early feel. It will change and evolve as we balance and tweak.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Lqcgoyt5_bs;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]We have also been working on the tileset for the Geon Droid level, and some props to go in it:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554507/6e948876a79f0d186c3bb24e8a3a11ca5b8950c4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Finally, here is a very early peak at the Droid section tiles and props from the third level. As you can see we're looking to do something quite different for this one![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554507/0005533486134b916cc579776d03f73d480722d5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Unboxing & Demo Media Blitz!
notes.content:
[p]There has been a media BLITZ with press and influencers doing unboxing & let's plays of the demo, to coincide with the upcoming [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/robhwson/hyper-sentinel-fusion-2"]Kickstarter campaign[/url]. Check it out:[/p][p][/p][h3]UNBOXING & LET'S PLAY[/h3][p]Check out [url="https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2509860880?tt_content=vod&tt_medium=mobile_web_share"]this unboxing[/url] by Twitch streamer RainaTheMouse of the 3.5" Mega Floppy (USB) Collectors edition which is exclusively available on [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/robhwson/hyper-sentinel-fusion-2"]Kickstarter[/url]:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554507/30cb96380b32b36906bca7d274b95b519e4efa1b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]MAGAZINE INTERVIEW[/h3][p]Pick up the latest issue of Retro Gamer magazine for a 2-page interview about the game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554507/d2f67dcbb9a3c436be12cd6ff9d2796f7774f543.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]MARIO KART WORLD REVIEW PROMO[/h3][p]Check out this Hyper Sentinel Fusion promo at the start of a Mario Kart World review:[/p][previewyoutube="YKRXGKnrr-g;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]ASHENS PLAYS THE DEMO[/h3][p]Movie-star, filmmaker, comedian and critic Ashens plays the demo [url="https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2501999351?t=00h55m26s"]live on his Twitch stream[/url].[/p][p][/p][h3]MORE YOUTUBERS PLAY THE DEMO[/h3][p][url="https://youtu.be/LDx6iru8yNw?si=Jp90pxw_oM8ontiE"]Backpackbrain[/url][/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/S3botAqw6fQ?si=rR5sTzms8fK55AlK"]Dr. Incompetent[/url]
[url="https://youtu.be/4B3VlUFFg9o?si=yqnAjDWJ9Bqu8pE9"]Game Wisdom[/url][/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/apamKK_w7I4?si=xhcdndHhwNgmS34C"]BH Indie Gaming[/url][/p][p][/p][h1]MORE TO COME[/h1][p]This is just the beginning, as the build up to the new [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/robhwson/hyper-sentinel-fusion-2"]Kickstarter campaign[/url] continues, we've got loads more coverage lined up![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Free Demo LIVE!
notes.content: [p]We are proud to announce that the first [i]Hyper Sentinel Fusion[/i] DEMO is now LIVE, to coincide with the upcoming [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/robhwson/hyper-sentinel-fusion-2"]Kickstarter campaign[/url]. We'd love to get your feedback on the demo, so strap in pilot![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://hypersentinelfusion.com/x/cdn/?https://storage.googleapis.com/production-websitebuilder-v1-0-2/722/1829722/zILOjWo4/23e5fe72597840c68c7195f003c0298c"][/img][/p][p]We are doing an awesome 3.5" Mega Floppy Micro Drive (USB) physical edition of the game too, available exclusively on the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/robhwson/hyper-sentinel-fusion-2"]Kickstarter campaign[/url].[b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Free Demo - Coming Soon!
notes.content: [p]You will soon have the opportunity to sample Hyper Sentinel Fusion for yourself with a limited demo launching later this month.[/p][p][img src="https://hypersentinelfusion.com/x/cdn/?https://storage.googleapis.com/production-websitebuilder-v1-0-2/722/1829722/zILOjWo4/06b3c479cf4c40c9be13206962848879"][/img]The demo will feature a full game loop with three sentinel levels, three droid levels and a end-of-demo boss to defeat.[/p][p][img src="https://hypersentinelfusion.com/x/cdn/?https://storage.googleapis.com/production-websitebuilder-v1-0-2/722/1829722/zILOjWo4/fc2145c2b1b04ca09b2238e4fd5a2f3d"][/img]You will need to plunder the depths for Space Credits and Upgrade Cores to spend at the in-game Smugglers Console and Upgrade Console, to purchase new weapons and capabilities.[/p][p][img src="https://hypersentinelfusion.com/x/cdn/?https://storage.googleapis.com/production-websitebuilder-v1-0-2/722/1829722/zILOjWo4/60fccd68331547028226728a4087af09"][/img]You will also have the opportunity to explore a small section of the Moonbase to chat to characters and even to pet the dog.[/p][p][img src="https://hypersentinelfusion.com/x/cdn/?https://storage.googleapis.com/production-websitebuilder-v1-0-2/722/1829722/zILOjWo4/4ed58964f3444c6ba239796a84966c10"][/img][/p][p]We will let you know as soon as the demo goes live, and will be looking forward to your feedback, so watch this space![/p]
